title: nbn service fault affecting Lavington, NSW
current_summary:
One nbn service in Lavington, NSW was affected from 11:11 am AEDT on 29 October 2026. Service was restored at 4:25 pm AEDT the same day.

Remote troubleshooting confirms the site is isolated due to a power outage and the backup batteries depleting. Services are expected to restore when the external power returns.

Resolution: Power has been restored to nbn network equipment

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

cause.reason: Power outage affecting the nbn site serving the area

updates.content: One nbn service in Lavington, NSW is affected. The fault was reported at 11:11 am AEDT on 29 October 2026, and no restoration estimate has been provided yet.

The cause has been identified as a power issue at the local nbn site. No restoration time has been provided yet.

Remote troubleshooting confirms the site is isolated due to a power outage and the backup batteries depleting. Services are expected to restore when the external power returns.
nbn has confirmed that power has been restored to the affected site and service has been restored as of 4:25 pm AEDT on 29 October 2026. This outage is now resolved.
